title: Be accredited to operate a bus service
what: Be accredited as the operator before operating a public passenger (bus) service.

sources.title: Passenger Transport Act 2014 (NSW)
sources.publisher: NSW Legislation (via the Open Australian Legal Corpus)
sources.quote: A person must not operate a public passenger service unless the person is accredited as the operator of that service.
